nativeCapabilities.subagents: foreground/background Task delegation with isolated context
nativeCapabilities.customAgents: .cursor/agents/*.md, with compatibility loading for Claude and Codex agent locations
nativeCapabilities.worktrees: managed isolated checkouts for parallel/background work
nativeCapabilities.approvals: run modes and command/tool approval policies are surface configuration
nativeCapabilities.resume: subagent IDs and agent sessions can be resumed when supported

dispatchGuidance: Load .cursor/rules/orchestrator.mdc, then use the run item and matching role profile.
Use foreground subagents for dependent work and background subagents for independent workstreams.
Use native worktrees for parallel writers; apply results only after review and verification.
Keep platform command syntax outside the vendor-neutral run file.
Do not treat agentic/ as product source; product work stays in cli/, observability-gateway/, test-platform/, charts/, for-download/, scripts/, skills/, and documantations/.
If Task or worktree support is unavailable, use the rendered prompt in a separate Cursor session.
limitations: Subagent model availability can be changed by plan or admin restrictions.
Headless write mode and approvals differ from interactive mode.
